first_sql:
SELECT 
    asm.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    asm.CSNAME AS `股票名称`,
    ROUND(c1.F013N / 10, 1) AS `市值(亿美元)`,  -- F013N单位百万，换算为亿：百万元*100/1亿 = /10
    ROUND(c1.F007N * 100, 2) AS `股息率(%)`,
    c1.F008D AS `股息率更新日期`
FROM 
    COM3101 c1
    INNER JOIN AMERICAN_STOCK_MAIN asm ON c1.FIU_ID = asm.FIU_ID
WHERE 
    c1.F007N IS NOT NULL
    AND c1.F007N >= 0.025
    AND asm.MARKET_FLAG = 'US'
    AND (asm.SEC_TYPE IS NULL OR asm.SEC_TYPE NOT LIKE '%CHINA%')
ORDER BY 
    c1.F007N DESC
